author: Kroest
body:
hello,

I got temp- banned for advertising the overcast. i am appealing after 3 months because i want to make a few maps for the avicus. I regret the mistakes i made in the past, and i would highly appreciate it if you could unban me. I see potential in the avicus server, and I am willing to help you grow.

Regards,

Kroest
